card.name: Words leading into 'avoid' or 'not suitable'
card.fires_on: Small helper words (should, are, rather, better, be, left) right before the text says something is to be avoided, ignored, forgotten or is not suitable. It appears after a subject such as a drug, food or material.

modes.label: Should be avoided
modes.description: 'should' or 'be' after a drug, solution or food, just before 'avoided' or 'not be used'.
modes.example: Intra-arterial or periarterial injection<< should>> be strictly avoided.

modes.label: Better left or ignored
modes.description: Words like 'rather', 'better' or 'left' that lead into forgetting, ignoring or leaving something alone.

modes.label: Not suitable
modes.description: A linking word before a negative verdict on a material or option.
modes.example: tend to disintegrate in the rain and<< are>> not suitable.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning avoid or do not, such as avoid, 避免 and 尽量.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the text says something should be avoided or left alone.
